voice.name: Open Sector - Destroyer
voice.description: Male destroyer captain in his late thirties on an open bridge in wind and spray, raising his voice over the sea, brisk and alert, a confident clear baritone with a crisp naval cadence and a light British accent, quick decisive orders, a sub hunter who enjoys the chase.
voice.sample: Bridge, captain here. Sonar reports a contact bearing two-seven-zero, range three thousand. Bring her round, full ahead both. Get the helicopter warmed up and stand by the mine rails. Nobody slips past this ship tonight.

ready: Destroyer commissioned. Sonar and helicopter ready.

fire.prompt: Twin 40mm Bofors anti-aircraft autocannon on a modern destroyer firing a rapid burst, heavy thumping pom-pom-pom reports with metallic clatter of shell casings on a steel deck, outdoors at sea, no music, no voice

move.prompt: modern destroyer steam turbines spinning up with a rising whine, twin propellers churning the sea and a bow wave hissing along the steel hull, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: A warship torn by a huge explosion at sea, steel hull groaning and breaking apart, secondary blasts, hissing steam and water rushing in as it sinks, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Heavy spiked naval contact mine rolling off a steel rail on the stern of a ship with a metallic clank and dropping into the sea with a deep splash, close, no music, no voice
